brief: Before the heat event, address the oil level sight glass reading below the minimum mark at ambient, as instructed in SOP-016. Because the outstanding defect notice from the last inspection round is still current, review and address the deferred work in accordance with SOP-016. Furthermore, note that the unit's 33-year age and thermal exposure indicate irreversible cellulose insulation ageing per MG-023. Cited documents: SOP-016, MG-023.
